استرعيت (form X)
# اِسْتَرْعَيْتُ (istarʕaytu) /is.tar.ʕaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اِسْتَرْعَيْتَ (istarʕayta) /is.tar.ʕaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اِسْتَرْعَيْتِ (istarʕayti) /is.tar.ʕaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# اُسْتُرْعِيتُ (usturʕītu) /us.tur.ʕiː.tu/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
